name: duo-compact-session
description: the existing composer and activity footer use a compact one-row dock at the 466x678 Duo cover viewport without losing controls or targets

allowlist..actions: PromptCard and PaneScaffold share the action-slot grammar
allowlist..body: SessionChrome's status body and the transcript's body share the pane body grammar
allowlist..cadenceSlot: SessionChrome and PaneScaffold share the cadence-slot grammar
allowlist..chevron: ModelSwitch and ToolCallItem share the inline disclosure chevron grammar
allowlist..head: RepoLocation's head composes the tool-call clampedHead rule for middle-truncated path text
allowlist..leading: Composer and StatusBar share the dock-leading region
allowlist..link: RepoLocation and Button share the inline link treatment
allowlist..row: StatusRow and ToolCallItem share the transcript row grammar
allowlist..trigger: ModelSwitch and ToolCallItem share the disclosure trigger grammar

mutation.declaration: remove the compact-cover composer and statusbar overrides, restoring the two-line empty editor and original dock framing
mutation.expect: the empty/live footer exceeds its compact height budget and the fixture reports the original two-line editor minimum
